title: Tools and Black Friday?
body:
I’ve got my eye on the following items and, with Black Friday sales coming up, I’m wondering if it’s worth waiting for a discount or just buying them now.
The tyre inflator is more of a "want" than a "need". Realistically, it would probably only save me around four trips to the petrol station each year, so I’m unlikely to buy it unless there’s a really good Black Friday deal.
The Makita pruning shears, on the other hand, are something I’d get reasonable use out of.
For those who have followed Black Friday sales in previous years, are these already decent prices, or is it worth waiting a few more weeks for potential discounts?
Makita 18V Brushless Pruning Shears DUP181Z - Skin Only @ $265
